@@U00293@@
Yes, and what have we but a dog, no more, no phantom here. It growls, hangs back, grovels on its belly in the grass, wags its tail. What more could you want from a dog? PAUS As Come! Come join us! Here! Come!

@@U00295@@
It’s a stupid beast of a poodle. You stop, he stops; you speak, he jumps up; you lose something, he finds it; throw your stick in the water, he'll leap in after it.

@@U00297@@
Right you are. No sign of any spirit here. Just doing what he was taught.

@@U00299@@
A dog as well trained as this might well win a philosopher's favor. I'd say he deserves you, sir. His student masters have made him an apt scholar.

@@U00300@@
(They enter the city gate.)

@@U00302@@
浮士德 enters with the poodle.

@@U00304@@

@@U00293@@
是的，我们除了一条狗之外什么都没有，这里没有幽灵了。它咆哮，向后退缩，趴在草地上，摇尾巴。你还想从狗身上得到什么？暂停 来吧！快来加入我们吧！这里！来！

@@U00295@@
这是一只愚蠢的狮子狗。你停下来，他也停下来；你说话，他跳起来；你丢了东西，他找到了；把你的棍子扔进水里，他会跟着它跳进去。

@@U00297@@
你是对的。这里没有任何灵魂的迹象。只是做他被教导的事情。

@@U00299@@
像这样训练有素的狗很可能会赢得哲学家的青睐。我想说他值得你，先生。他的学生大师使他成为一名聪明的学者。

@@U00300@@
（他们进入城门。）

@@U00302@@
浮士德带着贵宾犬进来。
